Definition: from G3844 and G3664; alike nearly, i.e. similar:--like.
BiblicalUsage: Paromoios means like, nearly alike, similar. It appears once, in Mark 7:13, where Jesus tells the Pharisees they make the word of God of none effect through their tradition, and many such like things do ye.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tradition that cancels God's word is not tradition at all, it is disobedience with a respectable name.
